{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin — inject durable user-set session/global must-do / must-not requirements into the model at conversation start (Baize).","id":"gh:1352441100","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-baize-rules","slug":"bvcvb/dsh-baize-rules","topics":["agent","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin","rules"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin — inject durable user-set session/global must-do / must-not requiremen"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ts into the model at conversation start (Baize)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-baize-rules"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English | 简体中文**　—　中文说明见 README.zh.md。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-baize-rules` (Baize) is a dsh plugin that injects **user-set, durable "must-do / must-not" requ"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"irements** — plain-text rules — into the model at conversation start as a *sourced* `user/message`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The name comes from **Baize (白泽)** — a mythical beast said to "understand the nature of all creature"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"s, know the names of all things, and comprehend the principles of everything." It carries the behavi"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"oral baseline that the user sets for the model."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Rules are **plain text** with no `must`/`mustNot` markers — whether something is "must-do" or "mus"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"t-not" is expressed by the language of the body itself (e.g. `Write comments in Chinese.` = must, `D"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"o not delete the tests.` = must-not).
- Injection happens at the **start of a conversation**: the cu"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"rrently active rules are injected into the model request as a **persistent** `user/message`, wrapped"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" in a `<system-reminder>` frame, with `source.kind='plugin'` and `plugin='baize-rules'`.
- **No rule"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"s → no injection**; if the byte budget shrinks such that all rules are cut, it returns `undefined` a"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"nd never injects an empty reminder shell."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Feature | Description |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| **Three scopes, all injected** | `global` (all sessions) / `session` (current session) / `project`"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" (the session's working directory — this directory only): all three reach the model |
| **Persistenc"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"e** | Everything is written to `$DSH_HOME` (default `~/.dsh`); survives across sessions and restarts"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" |
| **Specificity wins** | Render order `project > session > global`; when the byte budget is tight"},{"id":"p9s5","text":", the more specific rules are preserved first |
| **A corrupt file never breaks a step** | Rule file"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"s are read tolerantly: a broken or hand-edited file degrades that scope to empty and surfaces a `pro"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"blems` warning, instead of failing the conversation |
| **Deduplication** | Suppresses duplicate inj"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"ection by SHA-1 digest of the rendered text; optional `injectAtEveryStep` forces a refresh on every "},{"id":"p9s9","text":"step |
| **Stays present in long threads** | The snapshot is republished when the text changes, afte"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"r a session lifecycle change (`startup` / `resume` / `clear` / `compact`), and once the last copy is"},{"id":"p9s11","text":" `refreshAfterSteps` steps old (default 20) — so the rules are never left behind only at the top of "},{"id":"p9s12","text":"a long conversation |
| **Escape protection** | Literal `</system-reminder>` in rule bodies is escap"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"ed so user text can't close the plugin's frame |
| **Command + API share the same source** | The `/b"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"aize-rules` command and the front-end panel use the same store/core, so there is always a single sou"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"rce of truth |
| **Tags** | Rules can carry free-text tags (`flow`, `#frontend`) that the panel filt"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"ers by. Panel-only by default — tags cost no model-context budget (`injectTags` opts in) |
| **Templ"},{"id":"p9s17","text":"ate library** | Save frequently used rules as templates (body + tags) and apply them to any scope; e"},{"id":"p9s18","text":"xport/import the library as JSON to move it across machines and sessions. Applying a template makes "},{"id":"p9s19","text":"a **content copy** — later template edits do not rewrite the rules you already added |
| **Conflict-"},{"id":"p9s20","text":"safe writes** | Every write carries the file version it read; if another window changed the file in "},{"id":"p9s21","text":"between, the write is **refused with a retry hint** instead of silently overwriting |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### How this compares to `AGENTS.md` instructions"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"dsh ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions`, which loads the workspace instruction chain (`AGENT"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"S.md` / `CLAUDE.md`). The two are complementary — pick by *where the rule has to live*:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| | `AGENTS.md` (built in) | `dsh-baize-rules` (this plugin) |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Where it lives | A file inside the repository | `$DSH_HOME/rules/*.json`, plus the panel |
| Reach"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" | Everyone working in that repository | Your machine: all sessions, one session, or one directory |"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"
| Version control | Committed, reviewed and shared with the team; travels with the repository | Out"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"side the repository; travels with `DSH_HOME` |
| How you change it | Edit the file; the change lands"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" on the next file touch or session resume | Edit it in the panel or with `/baize-rules`; the next st"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ep injects it |
| Best for | Project conventions that belong to the project | Personal, cross-projec"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"t, or per-conversation requirements |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Both inject a sourced `user/message` framed with `<system-reminder>`, and both carry the same preced"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ence sentence, so they reinforce rather than fight each other."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> dsh plugins are distributed from npm and installed into a profile via `dsh plugin`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Peer dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/*`, `react`, etc.) are provided by the dsh profile; if any are miss"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ing, pnpm resolves them against `peerDependencies` in the profile directory."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Uninstall"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"If the entry lingers in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, delete that line from
`$DSH_HOME/profil"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"es/web/package.json` and restart dsh again. Your rule files under
`$DSH_HOME/rules/` are not touched"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" — delete them by hand if you want a clean slate."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Try it without touching your running setup"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Install into a **separate profile** so your currently running dsh stays unchanged:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`--dump-config` only composes and prints the tree; it does not start a server, so it is safe to run
"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"alongside your live dsh. To actually try the plugin in that profile, run `dsh --profile smoke`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"> Note on `pm2 restart dsh`: it reloads the profile you are running. Install/remove only changes the"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"
> profile on disk — nothing takes effect until the next boot (or that restart)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Local development (link)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"If you haven't published yet, or want to pick up source changes live, use this directory as a link d"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"en't published yet, or want to pick up source changes live, use this directory as a link dependency:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory and add `dsh-baize-rules` to `dsh.profile.bundles`."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### What the model actually sees"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"(The `Project requirements (this directory only):` section appears only when the session has a worki"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ng directory **and** that directory has active rules.)"}],"truncated":true}
